data.checkFirst: The import checks every row first. One invalid row stops the import, and nothing is imported.
data.columnsOptional: Optional columns: content, status, tags, board, author_email, author_name, created_at and source_id. A CSV export from another feedback tool, such as Canny or Nolt, also works as it is: its usual column names and status words are recognized. Vote counts are not imported.
data.companyColumns: Columns: name, domain, external_id, plan and mrr, the monthly revenue such as 1250.50. An empty cell keeps the stored value.
data.companyFileRequired: Choose a CSV file of at most 100 KB.
data.companyMatch: A row updates the company with the same external_id, else the same domain, else creates a company with its name.
data.deleteWorkspaceText: Delete the whole workspace, with its projects and tasks, in the workspace settings.
data.description: Import posts from a CSV file, export your data and delete it.
data.downloadFailed: The file could not be downloaded.
data.expired: The file expired. Start a new export.
data.exportCsvText: Download posts, people, companies or conversations as a CSV file.
data.exportRunning: An export already runs in this workspace. Try again when it finishes.
data.exportText: The file holds only the rows that you can read. One export runs at a time.
data.fileRequired: Choose a CSV file of at most 10 MB.
data.importCompaniesText: Create or update companies and their monthly revenue from a CSV file.
data.importCompaniesTitle: Import companies from a CSV file
data.importCsvText: Add posts to a board from a CSV file.
data.importTitle: Import posts from a CSV file
data.openFailed: The workspace settings could not be opened.
data.title: Data & Import
data.wipeList: This deletes the feedback, support, help center, status page and customer data. It also deletes the integrations, webhooks, API keys, OAuth clients, support teams, sending domains, workflows, macros, SLA policies and ticket types. The workspace, its members, projects and tasks stay. You cannot undo this.
data.wipeText: Delete all feedback, support, help center, status page and customer data of this workspace.
data.wipeTitle: Delete all feedback and support data?

integrations.connectText: The connection keeps these values. This page does not show them again.
integrations.description: Connect the tools that your team uses. Only people who can manage settings can connect or disconnect a tool.
integrations.disconnectFailed: The integration could not be disconnected.
integrations.disconnectText: This deletes the connection, its credentials, its event mappings and its links. Queued deliveries are cancelled.
integrations.noApp: This instance has no OAuth app for this provider yet. Ask an administrator to add one.
integrations.notReady: The connection could not be saved. Check the values, or ask an administrator to finish the setup of this provider.
integrations.rejected: The provider rejected the values, or it did not answer. Check the values and try again.
integrations.title: Integrations
